import pandas as pd

# Get recent S6 trips (last 10 days before now)
trips = tables['trips']

# Filter for S6 (season 6), recent days (85-91)
recent = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fished_date_t'] >= 1910)].copy()

# Calculate yt/angler by day and class
daily_stats = recent.groupby(['fished_date_t', 'fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily_stats['yt_per_angler'] = daily_stats['yt'] / daily_stats['anglers'].replace(0, 1)

# Sort by date descending
daily_stats = daily_stats.sort_values('fished_date_t', ascending=False)

print("Recent S6 Fleet Data (d85-d91, last 10 days):")
print(daily_stats[['fished_date_t', 'fished_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].head(40))

# Also check what's further back (spring peak around d14-60)
spring = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 14) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 70)].copy()
spring_stats = spring.groupby(['fished_date_t', 'fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
spring_stats['yt_per_angler'] = spring_stats['yt'] / spring_stats['anglers'].replace(0, 1)
spring_stats = spring_stats.sort_values('fished_date_doy')

print("\n\nS6 Spring Peak Data (DOY 14-70):")
print(spring_stats[['fished_date_t', 'fished_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

# Show peak values
print("\n\nTop 10 S6 Catches by yt/angler (DOY 14-70):")
top_peaks = spring_stats.nlargest(10, 'yt_per_angler')[['fished_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']]
print(top_peaks.to_string())
